description.en: An elongate capsule contains distinctive spirally marked seeds.
description.zh: 延长蒴果内含具螺旋纹的特殊种子。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Spirematospermum wetzleri, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Spirematospermum wetzleri 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Long multi-seeded capsule with ribbed walls differs from horned endocarps and winged fruits.
distinctness.zh: 具肋壁长形多籽蒴果区别于角状内果皮和翅果。

modeling_brief.en: Use one slightly open capsule with a few inseparable seed forms; seed grooves may be low relief rather than dense mesh.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作一枚略开蒴果及少量不可分割种子形，籽槽用浅浮雕而非密网格。

uncertainty: Family placement remains debated; associated rhizomes and leaves are not separate concepts.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
